tasks.title: Import-tracer accuracy: resolve from-package-import-submodule and __init__ edges
acceptance_criteria: harness/wire_up.py adds _resolved_graph and check_wired/sweep_modules use it
genuinely-wired modules (agy_pool, control_gate, hooks/rpc/*, rebuild/*, narrow_fuzz/*, overseer cluster) classify WIRED
tests/harness/test_wire_tracer_accuracy.py passes; test_wire_up.py, test_sweep_classifier.py, test_live_root_reconciliation.py still pass
tasks.objective: Make check_wired and sweep_modules resolve from-package-import-submodule, dotted, and package-__init__ import edges via a new pure helper _resolved_graph, so modules that ARE reached from a live root through those forms stop being mis-reported as orphans.

spec.objective: Make check_wired and sweep_modules resolve from-package-import-submodule, dotted, and package-__init__ import edges via a new pure helper _resolved_graph, so modules that ARE reached from a live root through those forms stop being mis-reported as orphans.
functional_requirements: Add a new pure top-level helper _resolved_graph(repo_root, modules) -> dict that returns an augmented {node -> set(deps)} graph over the non-test modules PLUS seed (__init__/conftest) nodes.

_resolved_graph starts from module_import_graph(root, modules) and AST-augments it: resolve `from BASE import NAME` (absolute and relative) to BASE.NAME and BASE when they map to a known module rel-path or a package __init__ seed; resolve `import a.b.c` to its module; include seed __init__ imports so reachability flows through packages.
check_wired builds its graph via _resolved_graph(repo_root, modules) instead of module_import_graph(repo_root, modules); all other behaviour is unchanged.
sweep_modules builds its graph via _resolved_graph(root, modules) instead of module_import_graph(root, modules); all other behaviour is unchanged.
Pure: stdlib only (ast imported locally). No process spawn, model/API/network call, or un-injected subprocess; only filesystem reads via discover + ast.parse.
spec.interfaces: _resolved_graph(repo_root, modules) -> dict[str, set[str]] (augmented import graph over modules + seeds). check_wired and sweep_modules consume it in place of module_import_graph. discover.module_import_graph and discover_modules are consumed unchanged.
edge_cases: A `from pkg import sub` where pkg has an __init__ seed and sub is a module resolves to BOTH the sub module and (when pkg is imported as a name) the __init__ seed.
A module imported only by a package __init__ that is itself reachable becomes WIRED (reachability flows through the seed node).
A genuinely unwired module (imported only by tests, or not at all) stays ORPHAN -- the augmentation only adds edges that exist in non-test source.
Relative imports (`from ..rpc import x`) resolve against the importing file's package; level>1 walks up parents.
A syntactically invalid or unreadable file is skipped, never raising.
non_goals: No new import statement added to any production module -- only the tracer's visibility changes.
No reimplementation of discover.module_import_graph or discover_modules.
No change to LIVE_ROOTS, WireResult, SweepReport, discover_live_roots, mcp_crosscheck, or _grep_config behaviour.

unit_tests: real modules reached via from-package-import classify WIRED
test_spec.test_data_requirements: Runs against the real repo tree plus hermetic tmp fixtures supplied by the committed oracle.
